name: Matutinal-Threnody
description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs solar wind erosion patterns, stark under a black sky.

No wind, no voice, no weather: the landscape communicates in light and shadow alone, and it has plenty to say at sunrise. The only confirmed life is microbial, a chemosynthetic film that glows faintly where the ground weeps warmth.
the derelict space station in orbit still shows toolmarks half-finished. Whatever called everyone away did not give them time to say goodbye.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
